invariants.rationale: The method assumes 'profile' is accessed and used without null checks, indicating it should never be null at exit.
The 'context' variable is used as an argument to other methods, suggesting it must be non-null throughout.
'profile.getPartitionPaths()' is used to iterate partition paths, so it must not be null.
Trivially true, as a partitionPaths set must be in one of these states; included to show partition paths are always a well-defined collection.
If output workload stats are available, the map should also be non-null. This captures a key relationship from method usage.
